what_each_new_part_touches: Sub-steps 1-5: red axles go into the ends of the black hose, a grey connector and a blue pin are added at one end, and a black tile with a sticker goes on the plate (yellow box). The whole piece is fitted next to the seat (arrow).
where_everything_is_after: a black soft hose link with red end axles, connectors and a sticker tile is fitted at the seat

why.problem_solved: Builds a stiff rod link with end fittings (a Volvo-style label tile).
why.why_these_parts: A soft axle hose is a bendable shaft; the red axles are its end fittings.
why.sets_up_for_later: It becomes a link in the cab area.

review_note: Parts are read from small icons; the soft hose and the sticker tile have no catalog points so joins are open.
